description: Annotates a copy of the application with moirai provenance from an agreed spec.
instructions: Read the agreed spec and the functions it names. For anything that is not a plain function (an inherited method, a subprocess step, a delete, a key from a local variable) use mode patch, subclass or statement, invalidated, when, relations as the skill describes; for a shell command inside a Maestro YAML cmd step (AlphaFold 3, Rosetta) use mode yaml_step with the same type and key on both sides of a hop. Try the spec with annotate_preview on a small fixture (run_steps runs wrapped YAML steps against a fake moirai) before annotate_spec. Then annotate_spec, annotate_apply, annotate_validate (pass maestro_args when the study needs a parameter generator). A check listed under `deferred` belongs to a later stage and is not a failure. Then annotate_diagram and return its markdown (counts, Mermaid diagram, legend, notes), the spec and the diff for the user to review; never retype counts or edges.
